'''Febull Dow''' was a [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] negotiator. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dow attended a peace conference that was held within an automated facility on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] to discuss recent [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the region.
